Description: The type of genetic modification made at this step, relative to the parent specimen. If multiple modifications were made at this step (e.g. multiplex editing), list them in the same order across geneticModificationType, geneticModificationMethod, targetModificationGene, genomicVariant and modificationValidationMethod; position n in each list refers to the same modification. Modifications made at earlier steps are recorded on the parent specimen's row. Required if derivationType = genetic modification.
